gardien.text: A watcher keeps their eyes open… and their heart too. Go on, I'm counting on you!

soigneuse.text: Here we care for everyone, no exceptions. That's what Jesus did.

marchande.text: Dates, figs, warm bread! Have a fig, little watcher, it's on me.

passant.text: Lovely day in Zion! Have you seen the Keeper's lantern? It never goes out.

stele_lumiere.text: Carved in the stone: Jesus said: "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in the dark." (John 8:12)
The flame of the tower never goes out, to remind every watcher that the light of Jesus shines for them.

stele_eau.text: Carved in the stone: Jesus said: "Whoever drinks the water I give will never be thirsty again. It will become a spring of life inside them." (John 4:14)

stele_berger.text: Carved in the stone: Jesus said: "I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, my sheep know me, and I give my life for them." (John 10:11-14)

stele_cep.text: Carved in the stone: Jesus said: "I am the vine, you are the branches. Stay joined to me, and you will bear lots of good fruit." (John 15:5)

stele_graine.text: Carved in the stone: Jesus said: "The Kingdom of God is like a tiny seed. It is planted, and it grows into a big tree where the birds come to make their nests." (Matthew 13:31-32)
Look at the tree beside you: it grows each time you live a mission. God's Kingdom grows in your heart too.
